Fields.Name: LOD 0 Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the closest grass LOD ends; it then fades over LOD 0 Play.

Fields.Name: LOD 0 Play
Fields.Description: Fade length (m) after LOD 0 Distance: LOD 0 ends at Distance + Play.

Fields.Name: LOD 1 Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the middle grass LOD ends; it then fades over LOD 1 Play.

Fields.Name: LOD 1 Play
Fields.Description: Fade length (m) after LOD 1 Distance: LOD 1 ends at Distance + Play.

Fields.Name: LOD 2 Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the farthest grass LOD ends; it then fades over LOD 2 Play. The largest LOD 2 Distance + Play among the grass types of a grass area also sets how far around the camera that area's grass is gathered (times the area's scale and the load balancer's grass scale).

Fields.Name: LOD 2 Play
Fields.Description: Fade length (m) after LOD 2 Distance: grass ends at Distance + Play.
